description: The 2013 General Census of Population and Housing of Gabon (RGPL-2013) was run by the Direction Générale de la Statistique, and its global results report is posted as a PDF by UNFPA Gabon. Besides population tables by province and department, it has a housing chapter and a set of basic services tables. Table 40 counts the 431,471 ordinary households by dwelling type, with 53.5 percent in single-storey detached houses. Table 52 shows that 85.2 percent of households had an improved water source, 93.6 percent in urban areas against 45.1 percent in rural areas, and table 58 adds gas or electricity for cooking, flush toilets, car access to the dwelling and internet access. Coverage is national, with urban and rural splits. Format and access: free PDF, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: housing and services tables are not split by province; the office's own sites could not be used, as the old site was under reconstruction and the new one reset the connection; results of a newer census were presented in August 2026 but were not found online. Simulation uses: urban and rural gaps in water, sanitation and road access. Related records: none for Gabon censuses in the catalogue.

schema_summary: Tables 40 to 44: households by dwelling type (independent room, studio, single-storey detached house, semi-detached, apartment), tenure, land title, housing satisfaction and access difficulty. Tables 50 to 53 and 58: households with adequate refuse and waste water disposal, improved water source, gas or electricity for cooking, flush toilets, car access to the dwelling and internet, by urban or rural area and sex of household head. Table 32 ICT ownership; tables 33 to 39 poverty by province.
